abi.name: ds4_decode_scalars
abi.unused: Every original scalar override pointer is NULL; batched hash routing reads explicit current tokens.

literal_ranges.description: Original tile constants; no debug telemetry.
Complete private IQ2/Q2 SoA staging/mainloops, weighted SwiGLU/D2S6 epilogue and expert-major worklist numerical closure; exact boundaries verified during source preparation.

sources.excluded: Debug telemetry, original host runtime/global device catalog/context/pool/allocator/dispatch and dense Q8 core; jitLLM supplies facts/stream/borrowed buffers.

sources.receipt: Authenticated on spark-b against completed original-build numerical_cuda_source_sha256 before source-only copy.

closure_namespace: Named implementation namespace jitllm::kernels::ggml::ds4_moe::original; standard and CUDA dependencies preincluded outside; original extern template declarations retain external linkage.
authored_adapters: Bounds/shape/alignment/alias validation, explicit ID/weight row-stride packing, native facts and preselected dispatch, borrowed map/work/quantized storage, native stream-K fixup charged to one Run allocation, no original globals/runtime.

Tail guard128*144 is explicitly initialized only for freshly quantized input/down. Original default blanket YBUF and output memsets are OFF; small aligned Q2 output clear/sanitize remains original mandatory work.
Original router outputs compact [T,6]. A native six-of256 input is packed to distinct compact scratch; unused physical padding is never expert input.

Current D4 or canonical-Q8_1 input producer is optional but source address, generation, rows, width, layout and readable slack must match; it is read-only. The original conservative gathered input arena remains explicit.

Direct/materialized down D2R rejects output%128>=16 before any launch: its eight 16-row warps must all enter the same full/guarded CTA-barrier mainloop. Full 128-row tiles and even tails below16 remain eligible; Classic/Vector use distinct consumers and retain even output widths. Original numerical bodies are unchanged.

tiers.vector: T1..16 original aligned IQ2 G1; T2..8 uses original first-owner expert dedup. Canonical Q8_1 input/middle, aligned Q2 down split into <=8 columns, original output clear/sanitize and optional guarded six-slot sum. Experimental Q81 fused-down/Q8K env paths are not selected.
tiers.direct: pairs>=1024; compact D4 input, original expert maps + Tile32 G1 worklist + IQ2 gate/up/clamp/SwiGLU/weight/D2S6, Tile64 down worklist + Q2 down.
tiers.materialized: pairs>=1024; original shared expert-major map, gathered D4, Tile64 D2R paired gate/up, ds4_swiglu_weighted_f32, D2S6 gather by ids_destination and D2R Q2 down.
tiers.classic: Original MMQ SoA IQ2 gate/up and Q2 down templates with original sm_121 default tile choice128 maximum, original stream-K geometry and reused native fixup. Original classic weighted-clamp activation uses its distinct literal function.

coverage_limits: Cooperative router API is the original batch rows tier even for T1. Serial decode router_fused_coop with its live-token scalar remains an explicit follow-on.

Materialized implements >=1024pairs D2R only. Original default smaller materialized/shared-MMQ products with ds4_swiglu_weighted_f32 activation remain an explicit follow-on; Classic uses a different activation and is not a default replacement.
First complete executor scope is matched4096-row chunks,43layers,8K prefill and full final head. Ordinary suffix/decode and whole-model equality are not qualified by these primitive controls.
